C0292.title: Quanzhou Court Sentences 7 in SMS Bombing and Soft-Force Debt Collection Case
C0292.summary: In early September 2021, Quanzhou cybersecurity police discovered during routine patrols that individuals were selling SMS bombing and soft-force debt collection tools, such as 'Call You to Death' software, in overseas instant messaging groups.
